# Salt Analysis

Class 12 CBSE / ISC qualitative salt analysis writeups.
https://saltanalysis.com

Copper sulphate is blue. Ammonium chloride smells of ammonia. Write BaCl2, not Ba(Cl)2.

## Guides

- How to do salt analysis: https://saltanalysis.com/how-to-do-salt-analysis
- Viva questions: https://saltanalysis.com/viva
- Unknown salt quiz: https://saltanalysis.com/quiz
- Create a salt: https://saltanalysis.com/lab
